column1: # The server this engine's committed answers come from. default records the
# tapes: the Cloud Spanner emulator, released from the source tag v1.5.54 of
# GoogleCloudPlatform/cloud-spanner-emulator. The googlesql tree pins the same
# emulator for its parser's oracle (googlesql/testdata/pins.tsv); default is
# the driver's own, because the driver's answers are recorded from the
# service's clients and can move with an image bump of their own.
# parser judges spanner/parser/testdata/compat.tsv at the same emulator 1.5.54
# release so a judge revision bump rejudges compat.tsv without touching the
# parser judge revision 2 classifies GoogleSQL's parse-error fallback
# ("Statement not supported: <Kind>Stmt"), lookahead EXCEPT and duplicate
# DYNAMIC LABEL|PROPERTIES syntax refusals as reject, and re-asks CREATE VIEW
# missing SQL SECURITY with a SQL SECURITY INVOKER stand-in so the view query
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag, judge revision
